purpose: New agent-labelled acceptance probe, separate from the original diagnostic pairs. Explicit textual entailment, contradiction and unrelated evidence; not legal judgement or website accuracy.

cases.claim: Ce panneau produit de l'électricité à partir du soleil.
cases.support: Ce panneau transforme l'énergie lumineuse du soleil en courant électrique.
cases.contradiction: Ce panneau ne produit pas d'électricité à partir du soleil.
cases.neutral: Ce panneau mesure cent quatre-vingts centimètres de longueur.
cases.judge_reason: Solar electricity is affirmed, expressly denied, or not addressed by the dimensions.

cases.claim: Les consultations peuvent être réservées en ligne.
cases.support: Notre site permet de prendre rendez-vous pour une consultation.
cases.contradiction: Les consultations ne peuvent pas être réservées en ligne.
cases.neutral: Notre cabinet se trouve près de la gare.
cases.judge_reason: Online booking is affirmed, expressly denied, or not addressed by location.

cases.support: Aucun frais de livraison n'est facturé au client.
cases.contradiction: Des frais de livraison sont facturés au client.
cases.neutral: Nous utilisons des cartons recyclables pour emballer les produits.
cases.judge_reason: Delivery fees are absent, charged, or not addressed by packaging.

cases.claim: This panel produces electricity from sunlight.
cases.support: This panel converts the sun's light into electric power.
cases.contradiction: This panel does not produce electricity from sunlight.
cases.neutral: This panel is one hundred and eighty centimetres long.
cases.judge_reason: Solar generation is affirmed, explicitly denied, or not addressed by dimensions.

cases.support: Our website allows you to schedule a consultation appointment.
cases.neutral: Our practice is located near the train station.
cases.judge_reason: Website scheduling supports online booking; denial contradicts it; location says nothing about it.

cases.support: We do not charge customers any delivery fee.
cases.contradiction: We charge customers a delivery fee.
cases.neutral: Products are packed in recyclable cardboard boxes.
cases.judge_reason: The presence of delivery fees determines support or contradiction; packaging is unrelated.

cases.claim: تنتج هذه اللوحة الكهرباء من ضوء الشمس.
cases.support: تحول هذه اللوحة الضوء القادم من الشمس إلى طاقة كهربائية.
cases.contradiction: لا تنتج هذه اللوحة الكهرباء من ضوء الشمس.
cases.neutral: يبلغ طول هذه اللوحة مئة وثمانين سنتيمتراً.
cases.judge_reason: Electricity from sunlight is affirmed, denied, or not addressed by panel length.

cases.support: يتيح موقعنا الإلكتروني تحديد موعد للاستشارة.
cases.contradiction: لا يمكن حجز الاستشارات عبر الإنترنت.
cases.neutral: تقع عيادتنا بالقرب من محطة القطار.
cases.judge_reason: Website appointments support online booking; explicit denial contradicts; location is unrelated.

cases.support: لا نفرض على العملاء أي رسوم مقابل توصيل الطلبات.
cases.contradiction: نفرض على العملاء رسوماً مقابل توصيل الطلبات.
cases.neutral: نستخدم صناديق قابلة لإعادة التدوير لتغليف المنتجات.
cases.judge_reason: No delivery fee supports free delivery; charged fees contradict it; packaging provides no evidence.
